title: Missed Sunday's polio booth? Teams knock on GHMC doors till Nov 25

slides.head: Missed Sunday's polio booth? Teams knock on GHMC doors till Nov 25
What happened
slides.body: Field workers will visit households in GHMC areas on November 23, 24 and 25 to give oral polio drops to children under five who missed the booths.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The Sunday drive in Hyderabad, Rangareddy, Medchal Malkajgiri, Sangareddy and Hanamkonda hit 95.6% of its 18.01 lakh target.

slides.head: Children given polio drops on day one
slides.body: Day one already reached 17.21 lakh children, 95.6% of the five-district target.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: The drive used 29,712 vaccinators and 744 supervisors.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: The final coverage figure after the three-day house-to-house round. Ask: Which neighbourhoods are hardest for booth-day drives to reach?

Missed Sunday's polio booth? Teams knock on GHMC doors till Nov 25

After Sunday's booth day covered 17.21 lakh children in five districts, health teams visit GHMC homes on November 23-25 to reach those who missed it.

Why it matters: The Sunday drive in Hyderabad, Rangareddy, Medchal Malkajgiri, Sangareddy and Hanamkonda hit 95.6% of its 18.01 lakh target.

Source: The Hindu. Image: The Hindu
